rules.quote: add 'PDF' and file size to meaningful link text.
rules.violation_condition: A link to a PDF has link text that omits 'PDF', the file size, or both.
when: The link points to a published PDF.
rules.why: G-2 keeps the PDF publication condition with the check; E-2 attaches the following example to this link-text instruction.

covers.quote: When there are significant barriers to providing content in another format, at least:

rules.quote: create a landing page with a high-level summary of the content
rules.specification: The textual check concerns the summary on the landing page, not the technical creation of that page. The manual does not define 'significant barriers' or how much detail constitutes a 'high-level summary'; the publication condition needs contextual confirmation.
rules.violation_condition: A PDF landing page lacks a high-level summary of the PDF's content when significant barriers exist to providing the content in another format.
when: There are significant barriers to providing the PDF content in another format.
rules.why: G-2 retains the conditional trigger; the summary and the accessible-version request route are separate textual requirements under the one-finding test.

covers.quote: When there are significant barriers to providing content in another format, at least:

rules.quote: provide a way for people to request an accessible version – for example, an email address.
rules.specification: The manual does not define 'significant barriers', so that condition needs contextual confirmation. An email address is an example of an acceptable request route, not a required mechanism.
rules.violation_condition: Content offering a PDF provides no way to request an accessible version when significant barriers exist to providing the content in another format.
when: There are significant barriers to providing the PDF content in another format.
rules.why: G-2 keeps the condition and alternative request mechanisms together; the missing request route is distinct from a missing summary.
